message: Diagnostic log ring buffer reached 90% capacity during nightly burst.
Log buffer overflow: 1,284 diagnostic entries dropped during burst logging.
Log rotation delayed; backpressure on diagnostic writer thread caused dropped entries.
PMU voltage rail VDD_CORE dipped below brownout threshold (0.72V < 0.75V) during load transient.
PMU detected undervoltage event on rail VDD_CORE under fast load step.
Power sequencing violation: VDD_CORE asserted before VDD_IO stable.
Intermittent testbench timeout on regression run 41827; did not reproduce on rerun.
Config hash mismatch between build node A and build node B; retried and passed.
STA run completed with 3 waived exceptions carried over from the prior revision.
Sporadic X-propagation observed in gate-level simulation; cleared on rerun.
STA tool qualification check failed: tool version 4.2.1 not in qualified toolchain manifest.
Clock tree signoff performed with unqualified STA tool build; tool-qualification (TCL) evidence missing.
Clock skew signoff for ASIL-B clock domain relies on an unqualified timing analysis tool.
Power estimation model drift: predicted vs measured dynamic power diverged by 18%.
Power estimation model recalibration overdue; last calibration was 240 days ago.
Power estimation report generated using a stale characterization corner.
Memory controller reported uncorrectable multi-bit ECC error at address 0x3F2A11C0.
ECC single-bit error rate on bank 3 exceeded monitoring threshold (12 corrected within 1s).
Scrubbing cycle failed to clear persistent multi-bit fault in bank 3.
Watchdog fault-collection unit self-test passed at boot.
Firmware OTA update to slot B failed; automatic rollback to slot A did not complete, device left on staging image.
OTA update manager: A/B slot swap flag not cleared after failed update; next boot may load the staging image.
Spurious interrupt storm on GPIO pin 14; suspected missing input debounce filter.
GPIO pin 14 toggled 4,201 times in 10ms with no corresponding external event.
PLL lost lock on the ASIL-B functional clock domain during a voltage droop.
PLL output jitter of 142ps exceeds the 120ps spec limit for the safety clock.
CAN controller entered bus-off state after the transmit error counter exceeded 255.
CAN bus bit-error rate elevated on the safety communication channel; 37 errors in 100ms.
Thermal sensor reading stuck at 25.0C for 60s; plausibility cross-check against neighbor sensor failed.
Thermal monitor: implausible flat temperature during a known high-load workload.
TRNG online health test failed: repetition-count test tripped, entropy below threshold.
TRNG reseed deferred; conditioning component operating on a reduced entropy pool.
LBIST fault coverage measured at 89.2%, below the 90% target required for the ASIL-C block.
Scan test controller: coverage gap concentrated in the safety island logic.
Safety requirement SR-207 (watchdog fault-reaction time) has no linked verification result in the traceability matrix.
Watchdog fault-collection unit: verification evidence for safe-state timing marked TODO.
Requirements traceability tool dropped 2 trace links during matrix export; re-export restored them.
Trace tool export produced an inconsistent link count between the HTML and CSV outputs.
Sensor fusion accelerator produced NaN in the Kalman filter update under near-singular covariance input.
Sensor fusion output diverged from reference by more than 5 sigma on an adversarial edge input.
Cache coherency unit: stale cache line observed after a cross-core invalidation race.
Coherency protocol near-deadlock detected; recovered via a protocol reset on the safety-critical core.
